title: Tapestry T-shirt in a shop
slide_intent: Show an abstract brand image on a familiar object because context makes a graphic’s scale and texture easier to judge.
strategic_value: The large colored print on a white shirt can make Wise’s tapestry recognizable outside a screen.
demonstration: A shopper seen from behind wears a white shirt with a rectangular multicolor tapestry, surrounded by stocked aisles and holding a green basket.
practical_value: Compare the tapestry as a standalone print with its use behind digital symbols.

content_islands.name: Back print
content_islands.spec: Center the rectangular tapestry on the white shirt.

content_islands.name: Everyday setting
content_islands.spec: Retain the aisle, basket and shopper to establish use and scale.

reference_purposes.Expression: A shopper seen from behind wears a white shirt with a rectangular multicolor tapestry, surrounded by stocked aisles and holding a green basket.
reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates tapestry imagery printed on a worn shirt.
